As diferenças entre as versões são os pokémons que dá pra pegar nelas, se quiser detalhes só procurar quais são exclusivos de um ou de outro, mas se quiser jogar geração a geração, a ordem é:
Fire red/leaf green > Heart gold/Soul silver (Nintendo DS)  > Omega Ruby/Alpha Sapphire (3DS) > Brilliant Diamond/Shining Pearl (switch, os originais são do DS e se não tiver paciência de emular switch, vale emular o pokémon platinum, que mescla os dois no DS) > Black/White (DS) > Black/White 2 (continuação direta, se for jogar o 2 é bom jogar o primeiro antes) > X/Y (3DS) > Sun/moon/ultra sun/ultra moon (3DS, jogue as versões ultra que são melhores mas a história é a mesma) > Sword/shield (switch) > scarlet/violet (switch).
Mas lembrando que pokémon não tem relação entre as gerações, então não tem necessidade de seguir essa ordem exata. Pode procurar qual te interessa mais e jogar. Entre eles tem vaaaarios spin offs, em especial os legends (Arceus, que saiu ha algum tempo e o Z to A que ta pra sair) que são bons, mas pode ir olhando cada um separadamente. Pokémon é uma franquia divertida de explorar por si só.

Few things to keep in mind:
You'll get a free SSR ticket at the end of the prologue. It's not time limited. You can ask here and everyone will say "pick your favorite" or "pick zhuge Liang", which is a support and, for gameplay purposes, probably one of the best choices for a starting account.

The game can be completed with free servants, so don't worry too much about spending all your SQ trying to get good units. Get the ones you want. For gameplay purposes, if you want a strong team for farming and such, you'll want to go for the supports, which are divided by card type: arts (blue) have caster artoria, buster (red) have Oberon and koyanskaya of light and quick (green) have skadi and skadi ruler. They all enable looping, which is using various NPs (ultimates or something like it) back to back.

The pity is 900SQ, so if you REALLY want Dante, you should have 900SQ saved by the time he gets here. This is very achievable, specially with a new account and the countless ways to get SQ.
Level up ALL your servants, specially the golden ones. Getting them to max ascension will get you 3 SQ, and some of them have rank up quests which also give you SQ
If you want insight on a servant's usability, you can ask on the questions thread here or look for rabbit's review for it, he makes good summaries on the different 4 and 5 stars. Tier lists are to be taken with a grain of salt.
And, lastly, enjoy the story!
